text:
Maya: hey team — Maya here, joining as AE Monday. Quick checklist before Day 1: HubSpot/Gong/Dialpad, demo laptop image, and where the latest playbook + 1-pager collateral live. Also who to ping for demo slide customizations?
Onboarding Bot: welcome @Maya! :tada: Provision task created: https://redwood.in/onboard/Maya. Complete the form to auto-request seats and device.
Liam (sales-ops): hi @Maya — i'll own HubSpot and Gong. Fill the form and include your preferred email alias and timezone. For Dialpad choose softphone or direct number and tell me the caller ID string.
Maya: form submitted. alias maya@redwood.com. softphone preferred. caller ID: "Redwood - Maya"
Liam (sales-ops): got it. HubSpot queued, Gong invite sent (check spam). Dialpad softphone request logged. Typical turnaround <24h.
Hannah (IT): hi @Maya — for the demo laptop, mac-arm or ubuntu-22? We build images and push MDM. After image, run the bootstrap:
```
bash -lc "curl -fsSL https://dl.redwood/onboard.sh | sudo bash"
```
Tell me which OS and i'll kick off the build.
Maya: mac-arm please.
Hannah (IT): build started — ETA ~3 hrs. When ready you'll get an email with temporary creds.
Ravi (AE-buddy): welcome @Maya! i'll share the AE playbook, objection cheat sheet, and 3 recorded demos. I keep a "week0" shadow calendar — i'm free Tue 9:30 or Thu 2:00. DM me which you prefer.
Maya: Tue 9:30 works, thanks.
Taylor (marketing): @Maya i'll drop the product 1-pager, case studies deck, and the demo slide kit into Drive. If you need a tailored slide create, DM me company name + logo + 1-line and i'll assemble.
Maya: one small ask — where do we keep Loom consent language and templates for recorded demos?
Tools Bot: Loom access is provisioned by Tools. Consent language and templates: https://drive.redwood/sales/demo-resources (read-only until Tools grants access).
Liam (sales-ops): also complete the "Demo checklist" training module in Learning before your first shadow — it's in the onboarding email. Covers recording consent and call note conventions.
Maya: thank you all! excited to start. :sparkles:
